en: The postcard is divided into two sections: the top half shows a large, traditional European building complex with another smaller house beside it, surrounded by trees and a field in the foreground. The text above identifies the location as 'Ziegenhain i. Sa.' and describes the buildings as a 'Gasthof u. Brauerei' (inn and brewery). The lower half shows a decorated hall (Saal) with tables and chairs arranged for a gathering, featuring garlands and a chandelier.
